name: Antonio Giordano
headline: Functional & System Safety Engineer
Computer Engineer
summary: Computer Engineer with over 5 years of Functional and System Safety experience across defence and automotive programmes. Hands-on system safety engineering per **MIL-STD-882E**: Preliminary Hazard Lists (PHL), PHA, SRHA, SSHA and HAZOP, risk assessment with the severity/probability matrix, derivation of safety requirements and hazard tracking to closure. Complementary safety lifecycle management per **ISO 26262:2018** and **IEC 61508**: Safety Cases with Goal Structuring Notation (GSN), Safety Plans, DIAs and full requirements traceability aligned with ASPICE and OEM standards (SS 7740). Proven track record in qualitative and quantitative safety analyses (FMEA, FTA), safety-critical embedded software verification (MISRA, timing analysis, unit testing) on complex ECUs (OBC, SEooC, MICROSAR Safe), and representing safety teams during customer and OEM audits. Pioneer in applying human-in-the-loop Generative AI (RAG and LLM agents) to streamline safety compliance and analysis workflows.

experience.summary: Led defence system safety per MIL-STD-882E and automotive Functional Safety per ISO 26262, managing work products, embedded software verification and process compliance aligned with ASPICE and OEM requirements via SS 7740.
bullets: **Defence System Safety (MIL-STD-882E):** Prepared Preliminary Hazard Lists (PHL) and executed PHA, SRHA, SSHA and HAZOP for defence safety scopes; assessed risk with the MIL-STD-882E severity/probability matrix, derived safety requirements and tracked hazard mitigations to closure.
**Automotive Safety Analyses:** Performed software FMEA and FTA on an On-Board Charger (OBC) control system board using specialized safety software.

**Safety Lifecycle & Team Coordination:** Formulated, coordinated and monitored comprehensive safety plans, milestones and deliverables; mentored and guided project safety engineering team members across multi-disciplinary functions.

**Safety Cases & Documentation:** Authored, structured and maintained core safety artifacts including Safety Cases with Goal Structuring Notation (GSN) arguments, Safety Plans, Development Interface Agreements (DIA), confirmation measures and ISO 26262 compliance checklists.

**Embedded SW Verification & Architecture:** Defined software architecture and integration requirements for safety-relevant components (SEooC, MICROSAR Safe, MCAL); conducted SW unit design, unit testing and peer reviews, addressing MISRA compliance and static analysis findings.

**Timing & Real-Time Behavior:** Instrumented and analyzed timing, execution latency and runtime behavior of safety mechanisms and safety-critical execution paths to validate deterministic performance.

**Audits & Assessment Leadership:** Served as primary technical contact for safety and process topics with customers and Tier-1 suppliers; successfully prepared and led teams through FuSa, ASPICE and OEM assessments and audits.

**Generative AI Innovation:** Pioneered human-in-the-loop Generative AI workflows (RAG pipelines and autonomous agents) to automate compliance verification, evidence synthesis and traceability checking, significantly accelerating documentation cycles.
**Embedded C/C++ Development:** Developed firmware modules, build systems and debugging tooling for automotive control units.
**Integration Requirements:** Analyzed and managed system/software integration requirements to ensure baseline consistency.
